boundary_conditions: dT_dx(1) / (1 / wall_u_value + gap_effective_resistance) = (1 - shell_solar_reflectance_aged) * solar_irradiance_daily_mean + external_heat_transfer_coefficient * (ambient_temperature - T(1)) - shell_thermal_emittance * net_sky_longwave

parameters.name: indoor_temperature
parameters.justification: Conditioned interior at 25 C (x=0 interior side, the wall U-value includes the interior film).

parameters.name: ambient_temperature
parameters.justification: Daily-mean outdoor air on a hot summer day.

parameters.name: shell_thermal_emittance
parameters.justification: Ceramic glazes are silicate glasses with hemispherical emittance ~0.9.

parameters.name: net_sky_longwave
parameters.justification: Net longwave loss at ambient for a horizontal surface under a dry clear sky; a vertical facade sees about half sky and half warm ground/buildings, ~30-45 W/m2.
